content:
rebecca: quick sync  proposal: narrow SDK-visible routing headers to a tiny stable surface so client libs don't churn every time platform tweaks policy blobs. move richer policy payloads to an internal-only header added by the mesh. feedback?

omar: +1 for smaller public surface. what exact headers are we locking?

rebecca: thinking: `x-rw-route` (short k=v list), `x-rw-attr` (csv k=v for billing/tenant), `x-rw-route-ver` (negotiation). internal-only: `x-rw-baggage` (json, platform-internal). SDKs must not emit baggage by default.

li: console needs tenant & cost_center for dashboards. `x-rw-attr` should be required for public SDKs. If missing, console falls back to best-effort parse of `x-rw-route`.

sam: SDK ops note: proxies truncate headers >1KB. If platform attaches big JSON baggage it can get truncated and cause parsing errors (we saw `json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value`). Do we force base64 for baggage or forbid client-emitted baggage?

rebecca: prefer forbidding client baggage. Platform can enrich on internal hops. For Dedicated/Private only we can support an opt-in env var `RW_ALLOW_BAGGAGE` for the SDKs, disabled by default.

omar: ok. SDK compat plan: keep parsing both old wide header and new compact headers for 2 minor releases. Add a feature flag in SDKs `enable_internal_baggage` guarded by env var and docs.

ci-bot: FYI previous canary failed on edge-proxy: `header_parser: unexpected EOF while parsing x-rw-baggage`

li: that's the proxy truncation. Action: ops to bump header limit on internal proxies for the canary, but still don't allow public baggage.

sam: quota side: quota service currently reads route blob for `cost_center`. We'll update quota reader to prefer `x-rw-attr.cost_center` then fallback to route blob. That reduces breakage risk during rollout.

rebecca: nice. example headers we'll document: 
```
# public (SDKs)
x-rw-route: tenant=acme,env=prod
x-rw-route-ver: 1
x-rw-attr: cost_center=314,team=platform
# internal (platform only, added inside mesh)
x-rw-baggage: {"policy":"prefer-low-cost","trace":"abc123"}
```

omar: release plan: PRs in python/ts/go repos with parsing shim + tests, add RW_ALLOW_BAGGAGE env (no default). Run 2-week canary where Dedicated customers can opt-in. Deprecation notice for public baggage in 12w.

rebecca: doc-bot can you add a short migration snippet for SDK CHANGELOGs?

doc-bot: added draft changelog snippets to /docs/sdk-migration and will ping PRs.

ci-bot: canary scheduled Friday 08:00 UTC. Will post run logs here.

rebecca: thanks all  I'll open the RFC and link it here. Short followups: @omar draft SDK release note, @li update quota reader fallback, @sam ops bump proxy limits in staging.

omar: on it :white_check_mark:
